entities.name: Query protein (200 aa)
observations: 200-aa sequence has 48.2–48.5% identity and 96.5–99% query coverage to reviewed bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases.
Likely Mg2+-dependent nucleotide-triphosphate pyrophosphatase, with candidate substrates dITP, XTP and ITP; exact specificity is inferred from homologs.

Likely biological role is nucleotide-pool sanitation, limiting incorporation of noncanonical purines into nucleic acids; curated homolog annotation associates it with purine nucleoside triphosphate catabolism.

entities.name: Q8XI68
observations: Reviewed Clostridium perfringens dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase; UniProt annotation describes Mg2+-dependent hydrolysis of XTP, dITP and ITP to monophosphate products and a nucleotide-pool sanitation role.
